statistical_boundary: Deterministic configurations and repeated paired baselines, not independent random trials or player win rates.

policy_notes.asap: Each equipped core is tried in loadout order when legal; repair unused except repair_policy experiment.
policy_notes.hold: Core first legal time retained; cast during any active warning or at least 3 seconds after first legal time; this is not optimized timing.
policy_notes.repair_policy: After trying a core, try repair if any legal ally has HP <= 40% and missing HP >= 60; default legal target/payment selection retained.
policy_notes.first: First successful program of any kind; use first_core for pursuit/recoil timing.
policy_notes.granted: Shield assignment/refresh event amount; not net newly added shield or denominator of a true utilization rate.

variant_notes.striker_320: Only actor HP/maxHP 290 -> 320 in temporary instances.
variant_notes.warning_12s: Only board/colossus repeated warnings 10 -> 12 seconds using a subclass calling original resolution.
variant_notes.shoe_075: Only guard interval * 0.75, timer adjusted; no second equipment.
variant_notes.shoe_090: Only guard interval * 0.90, timer adjusted; no second equipment.
variant_notes.badge_040: Only striker HP/maxHP +40; not applied to mixed team.
variant_notes.badge_080: Only striker HP/maxHP +80; not applied to mixed team.
variant_notes.swap: Swap guard and striker slots 0/1, retain back row.
variant_notes.recommended: Pursuit spread, shield swap, mixed one_front_left.
